'''April 2001 Flatwoods tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Flatwoods, KY on 14 April 2001. [[John Tatta]] won it. It is known from John Tatta's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2085">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-flatwoods-ky-4-14-01d2085/ flatwoods-ky-4-14-01], DeckTech (John "Artoo-Detoo" Tatta, 15 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-15-flatwoods-ky-4-14-01d2085/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 14 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Flatwoods, KY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[John Tatta]]
